Re.note: One frequency, not a dispersion: the Raman E<sub>2g</sub> mode at Γ. Scored as the mean of the doubly degenerate pair the run returns (4.041 and 4.127 THz), and the floor is the SPLIT of that pair - a symmetry image of Γ is Γ itself, so the usual floor would be zero and claim a resolution the run does not have. Extracted with ten acoustic-sum-rule passes; one pass left the acoustic modes at −1.9 THz and moved this mode by 0.11 THz.
